# Arch-loop exploration (8 rows) -- PLA, nozzle 205C, bed 60C, M221 S100

**Not yet print-tested.** Generated by `arch_test.mjs`; no library function exists for this texture.

Each loop: anchor puddle A (in place, Z 0.2->0.6, e 0.3) -> extruded rise to H -> extruded bridge over span S at H -> extruded descent to Z 0.3 at B -> anchor puddle B. Strand flow e/d = 0.05 (about a 0.4mm round strand). Each loop is retracted (1.3mm) and the nozzle lifts straight up to H+1 before travelling, except in row G.

**Part fan**: the library never touches the fan; this file turns it on (`M106 S255`) for every row except C, and off at the end. If your printer runs the fan from the slicer only, rows B and C will look the same.

Calibration line: `freeformSolid` x=120-180, y=75, printed first (continues from the y=80 looped-spire-trace print). Loops run +X from X=20. `verifyLayout` (3mm min gap): ok=true, 0 warnings.

| row | Y | shape | dir | H (mm) | S (mm) | loops | pitch gap | rise / bridge / down F | top dwell | fan | ~mm3/s at bridge | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 25 | staple | x | 2.0 | 3.0 | 6 | 3.0 | 300 / 300 / 400 | - | on | 0.60 | staple, low and short -- the easiest case |
| B | 39 | staple | x | 3.0 | 3.0 | 6 | 3.0 | 300 / 300 / 400 | - | on | 0.60 | staple, taller -- does a 3mm leg stand? |
| C | 53 | staple | x | 3.0 | 3.0 | 6 | 3.0 | 300 / 300 / 400 | - | OFF | 0.60 | same as B with the part fan OFF -- isolates cooling |
| D | 67 | staple | x | 3.0 | 5.0 | 6 | 3.0 | 300 / 300 / 400 | - | on | 0.60 | staple, long 5mm bridge -- where does it start to sag? |
| E | 81 | arc | x | 3.0 | 4.0 | 6 | 3.0 | 300 (whole arc) | - | on | 0.60 | smooth half-ellipse instead of a staple |
| F | 95 | staple | x | 3.0 | 4.0 | 6 | 3.0 | 300 / 200 / 400 | 1500 | on | 0.40 | staple, 1.5s dwell at each top corner + slower bridge |
| G | 109 | staple (chain) | x | 2.5 | 3.0 | 6 | 1.5 | 300 / 300 / 400 | - | on | 0.60 | continuous chain: no retracts, a 1.5mm bed run joins loops |
| H | 123 | staple | y | 3.0 | 4.0 | 8 | 3.0 | 300 / 300 / 400 | - | on | 0.60 | crosswise loops (span along Y), 3mm pitch -- a pile row |

**What to look for**: do the legs stand (A vs B), does the bridge stay level or sag (B vs D, B vs F), does the fan matter (B vs C), does a smooth arc survive better than a staple (E vs B/D), does skipping retracts leave strings or cleaner loops (G), and does a crosswise row read as a pile when you stroke it (H). Squeeze a few loops: do they spring back or snap?

Totals: 2565 G-code lines, 56.9 mm commanded filament.
